edition: None found. District names come from the Emery County hosted Orangeville Zoning Map (https://emery.utah.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/ovzone.pdf), legend only.
caveats: No Orangeville zoning ordinance text was found. emery.utah.gov hosts only the map (legend: RR-1 Rural Residential, C-1 Commercial, I-1 Industrial, R-2 8000 Residential, R-4 8000 Residential). ZoningPoint (verified 2026-05-12) says no official zoning map or code is published online by the city; Zoneomics has no Orangeville code text.
Do NOT substitute other Utah codes (several unrelated RR-1 and C-1 districts exist elsewhere). Ask Orangeville City for its ordinance.
Every field except district names is null/empty because nothing was verified.
